lines.3: Haan, seven matlab saat, aur number 7. Ab ek naya shabd: nau. Nau ka number kya hai?
lines.4: Haan, nau ka number 9 hai! Ab do numbers ka fark socho. 6 aur 9 mein kya fark hai?
lines.5: Haan, tumne sahi dekha: 6 ka gol hissa neeche, 9 ka upar. Agar 6 ko ulta likhein, kya woh phir bhi chhah hoga?

lines.9: Haan, jab kuch nahi bachta, hum 0 likhte hain. Zero bhi number hai. Ab ulta gino: teen, do, ek. Uske baad kya aayega?
lines.10: Haan, ek ke baad zero aata hai ulta ginte hue. Ab chidiyaon ka socho: taar par teen baithi hain, teeno udd gayin. Kitni bachi?
lines.11: Haan, taar par zero chidiya bachi. Teeno udd gayin, isliye ek bhi nahi bachi. Aaj humne ginti ko numerals se milaya aur zero samjha. Kya aaj ke liye yahin rukei
lines.12: Haan, khelte hain! Main pehle ek game dhoondhti hoon. Tab tak bolo, main jo number bolun, utni ungliyan dikhaoge?
lines.13: Haan, ungliyan dikhana! Main bolun eight, tum aath ungliyan dikhao. Kitni ungliyan dikhaoge?
